body: The drone's delicate, rainbow-hued ribbon catches my eye as it glides across the path, leaving a trail of curiosity in its wake. The box, a vibrant, iridescent shape, seems to shimmer and dance in the sunlight, drawing me in with an otherworldly allure. I feel a sudden urge to investigate, my hands reaching out to gently touch the box's intricate patterns. As I draw nearer, a faint scent of garden herbs wafts up, enticing me to explore the contents within.
